description: This file contains a JavaScript module for configuring CKEditor toolbars, including classes and methods for initializing, grouping, and creating toolbar buttons and icons.

classes.name: ToolbarConfigurator.FullToolbarEditor
classes.description: Class responsible for initializing and managing the full toolbar editor instance, including toolbar button grouping and configuration.

classes.name: ToolbarConfigurator.AbstractToolbarModifier
classes.description: Base class for extending plugin configurations in CKEditor.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the toolbar editor, replaces textarea with CKEditor instance, and sets up toolbar buttons.

methods.name: groupButtonNamesByGroup
methods.description: Groups button names by their toolbar group.

methods.name: getGroupByName
methods.description: Retrieves a toolbar group configuration by its name.

methods.name: getCamelCasedButtonName
methods.description: Converts button name to camel case based on UI items.

methods.name: getFullToolbarGroupsConfig
methods.description: Returns the full configuration of toolbar groups.
